notes.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro — Sketch to CAD / 3D Print
notes.content:
Google released Gemini 3.1 Pro on Feb 19, 2026. The sketch-to-3D feature lives in Deep Think mode (which runs on 3.1 Pro under the hood).

What it does:
• Take a photo of a sketch or physical object → generates a full 3D model
• Outputs STL files ready for 3D printing
• Conversational edits after: "make that wall 2mm thicker", "add a snap clip"
• No CAD software or OpenSCAD knowledge needed

Relevant for AVA enclosures (Dash, Mini, Max) and any custom brackets/mounts.

How to try it:
Go to aistudio.google.com → select gemini-3.1-pro-preview → enable Deep Think mode → upload sketch or photo → describe what you want.

Benchmark: scored 77.1% on ARC-AGI-2 — more than double Gemini 3 Pro's performance.
